meta.title: Pat at the Dentist
meta.textType: personal details and what I need

paragraphs: My name is Pat, and I am seven. I live with my mom, my dad, my grandma, and my sister May. May is ten, and she is at school today. I am at the dentist with my mom. I have a toothache, and I can't eat. A nurse says, "Hello! What's your name?" "I'm Pat," I say. "How old are you?" she asks. "I'm seven," I say. "What's your address?" she asks. "I live in the white house next to the school," I say.

The nurse has curly hair and a kind smile. "What's the matter, Pat?" she asks. "I have a toothache. I need to see the dentist," I say. She puts a hand on my shoulder. "Your face is hot," she says. "I need to take your temperature." She puts a small thermometer in my ear. "It is a little hot, but it is not bad," she says. "I'm thirsty," I say. "I need a glass of water."

The nurse brings me the water. Then the dentist says, "Open your mouth." I open my mouth very wide. The dentist looks at my teeth. "You eat many sweets," says the dentist. "Brush your teeth every night." "Eat more fruit and salad, too." "I don't like salad," I say. "Try it, Pat," says my mom. The dentist fixes my tooth, and it does not hurt now. "Thank you," I say. Now I am hungry, and I need a big bowl of rice!
text.summary: Pat goes to the dentist with his mom because he has a toothache. He tells the nurse his name, his age, and his home, and he says what he needs.
